notes:
New profile bar, Play next, like dates and drag to reorder.
- Your profile now sits at the bottom of the sidebar: click it to open your profile, use the arrow to switch accounts, and the gear for Settings
- Right-click a song and choose Play next to have it play right after the current song
- Your Likes (and people's Likes tabs) show when each song was liked, next to the release date
- Drag songs to reorder your queue and the Link Up queue
- Pausing from a song's cover now pauses instead of restarting it
- The sign-in window opens bigger and centered
- Link Up has a new home (linkup.sclinkup.workers.dev); update to keep using it
